title: Verified team-identity registry for pick origination
policy: An alias may join two provider names only when an official or first-party source link demonstrates they are the same team in the same competition, and every alias declares the exact competitions it applies to ('applies_to'). Sponsor/abbreviation spellings are not silently inferred and an alias never crosses into a competition it does not declare. Every alias below carries its evidence links and is displayed on the published page. Any name without a registry entry remains unmatched; missing values stay blank and are flagged.
updated_by: arena-2e8b83a7 research session (every alias carries its own official source links and an explicit competition scope); extended by arena-c07e1b40 (NIP and Liquid for Stake Pulse Beat III, WBT for DraculaN Season 7, with a review note on outdated WBT evidence); extended by arena-35440d12 (2026-10-16): six scoped display-name joins for NODWIN Clutch Series #13, DraculaN Season 7 and PGL Bucharest 2027: Closed Qualifier — every entry carries first-party Gamma/HLTV/Hotspawn evidence and stays inside its declared competition. No sponsor-only or fuzzy join was added. Extended by arena-fe48a0df (2026-10-18): one scoped, evidence-linked identity join (Valve table name 6666 to Hotspawn/HLTV ex-6666) with a review note recording the 4-of-5 roster overlap.; extended by arena-1fb85c47 (2026-10-19): the reviewed 6666 -> ex-6666 join now covers CCT Europe 2026 Series #12 Play-In and #11, and one abbreviation join (Aurora YB -> Aurora Young Blud) was added for Stake Ranked Episode 6: Closed Qualifier. Both carry their fixture pages and HLTV match URLs.; extended by arena-c03ef201 (2026-10-19): the Stake Ranked Betclic -> Apogee Betclic display-name join (HLTV match 2399772 + Hotspawn fixture 1082152 evidence). Session c03ef201 also independently drafted the Aurora Young Blud -> Aurora YB join on the same fixture evidence; the reviewed entry above is kept as the single registry record.
